observer_plane: Newly constructed current observer tangent: normal=exact_estimated_normal at anchor, point=anchor wheelcentre−R*normal. This is NOT a claim to reconstruct the cached active synchronizer plane during unloaded intervals. No estimated-point float32 values or futuretruth needed.
normal_edge_policy: Evaluator downward-ray geometricnormal flagged ambiguous if normals of XY±10um probes differ by>1e-4rad. Exclude flagged rows from normalerror statistics with counts; retain height and availability. These are geometric proxies, never forceweighted normals.
input_precision: Use float64 precision.npz throughout geometry and timing; rollout.npz is only historical video/reference context.
crop_margin_reason: 2m ray range plus0.30m covers largest full3D camera-offset norm(<0.272m) under any body tilt, before outcomes. The crop is only private simulator/evaluator preprocessing.
